title: Luxury backstage lounge at a live concert venue, late afternoon. A rising…
content:
Luxury backstage lounge at a live concert venue, late afternoon. A rising female K-pop idol @image records a fun "Get Ready With Me" vlog on her phone while waiting for her stage call. The atmosphere feels warm, energetic, and authentic. Natural handheld camera movement from start to finish with quick, dynamic cuts. She constantly interacts with the lens through genuine smiles, playful teasing, eye contact, and spontaneous laughter. Eight seamless vlog-style shots unfold inside the same dressing room, creating a lively behind-the-scenes experience.
Character
A Korean female idol in her early 20s. Long silky dark brown hair with soft waves, glowing glass skin, expressive almond-shaped eyes, soft peach makeup, glossy lips, slim elegant figure. Wearing a stylish white cropped cardigan over a pastel blue mini dress with silver accessories and white knee-high boots. Cute, confident, and effortlessly charming.
Storyboard
Cut 1 (~2s · selfie) She opens the vlog with a bright smile while spinning once in front of the mirror. "Today's concert is finally here! Let's get ready together!"
Cut 2 (~2s · handheld room tour) She walks around showing her makeup station, flowers from fans, customized microphone, and stage outfit hanging nearby. "Look what everyone sent me today!"
Cut 3 (~2s · medium shot) She sprays perfume, fixes a bracelet, then smiles proudly at the mirror. "Almost ready!"
Cut 4 (~1.5s · cinematic close-up) Detailed shot of sparkling jewelry, polished nails, and glitter makeup catching the lights. Soft fabric movement and ambient backstage sounds only.
Cut 5 (~2s · selfie) She practices cute ending fairy poses, finger hearts, flying kisses, then laughs after making a funny face. "Which pose should I do on stage?"
Cut 6 (~2s · handheld) A stylist quickly enters to adjust her hair for a second. She giggles while staying focused on the camera. "They're always fixing something!"
Cut 7 (~2s · selfie walking) She walks through the backstage hallway, greeting dancers and staff with cheerful waves as everyone smiles back.
Cut 8 (~2s · final selfie) The stage manager announces her performance. She takes a deep breath, winks at the camera, forms a heart with both hands, then jogs excitedly toward the glowing stage entrance.
Final Line: "Wish me luck... let's make amazing memories together!"

es.content:
Lujoso lounge de backstage en un recinto de concierto en vivo, tarde avanzada. Una idol femenina de K-pop en ascenso @image graba un divertido vlog de “Get Ready With Me” con su teléfono mientras espera su llamada al escenario. La atmósfera se siente cálida, enérgica y auténtica. Movimiento de cámara en mano natural de principio a fin, con cortes rápidos y dinámicos. Interactúa constantemente con la lente con sonrisas genuinas, bromas juguetonas, contacto visual y risas espontáneas. Ocho tomas fluidas estilo vlog se desarrollan dentro del mismo camerino, creando una experiencia vibrante detrás de cámaras.

Character  
Una idol coreana de veintitantos años. Largo cabello castaño oscuro sedoso con suaves ondas, piel de cristal luminosa, ojos almendrados expresivos, maquillaje suave en tonos melocotón, labios brillantes, figura esbelta y elegante. Lleva un elegante cárdigan corto blanco sobre un minivestido azul pastel, con accesorios plateados y botas blancas hasta la rodilla. Linda, segura de sí misma y encantadora sin esfuerzo.

Storyboard  
Cut 1 (~2s · selfie) Abre el vlog con una sonrisa radiante mientras da una vuelta frente al espejo. "Today's concert is finally here! Let's get ready together!"  
Cut 2 (~2s · handheld room tour) Camina mostrando su estación de maquillaje, flores de los fans, un micrófono personalizado y el outfit del escenario colgado cerca. "Look what everyone sent me today!"  
Cut 3 (~2s · medium shot) Se rocía perfume, se acomoda una pulsera y luego sonríe orgullosa al espejo. "Almost ready!"  
Cut 4 (~1.5s · cinematic close-up) Toma detallada de joyas brillantes, uñas pulidas y maquillaje con glitter captando las luces. Suave movimiento de la tela y solo sonidos ambientales de backstage.  
Cut 5 (~2s · selfie) Practica poses adorables de ending fairy, finger hearts, besos al aire, y luego se ríe después de poner una cara graciosa. "Which pose should I do on stage?"  
Cut 6 (~2s · handheld) Una estilista entra rápidamente para ajustarle el cabello por un segundo. Ella se ríe mientras sigue concentrada en la cámara. "They're always fixing something!"  
Cut 7 (~2s · selfie walking) Camina por el pasillo de backstage saludando a bailarines y personal con alegres gestos de la mano, mientras todos le devuelven la sonrisa.  
Cut 8 (~2s · final selfie) El stage manager anuncia su actuación. Ella respira hondo, guiña un ojo a la cámara, forma un corazón con ambas manos y luego corre emocionada hacia la entrada iluminada del escenario.

Final Line: "Wish me luck... let's make amazing memories together!"

fr.content:
Salon lounge luxueux en coulisses dans une salle de concert en live, en fin d’après-midi. Une idole féminine de K-pop en pleine ascension @image enregistre un vlog amusant « Get Ready With Me » sur son téléphone en attendant son appel pour monter sur scène. L’ambiance est chaleureuse, énergique et authentique. Mouvement de caméra à main levée naturel du début à la fin, avec des coupes rapides et dynamiques. Elle interagit constamment avec l’objectif par des sourires sincères, des taquineries espiègles, des regards caméra et des éclats de rire spontanés. Huit plans fluides de style vlog se déroulent dans la même loge, créant une expérience vivante des coulisses.

Character  
Une idole coréenne dans la vingtaine. Longs cheveux brun foncé soyeux aux ondulations douces, peau lumineuse effet glass skin, yeux en amande expressifs, maquillage pêche doux, lèvres brillantes, silhouette fine et élégante. Elle porte un cardigan blanc court et stylé par-dessus une mini-robe bleu pastel, avec des accessoires argentés et des bottes blanches montantes jusqu’aux genoux. Mignonne, confiante et irrésistiblement charmante.

Storyboard  
Cut 1 (~2s · selfie) Elle ouvre le vlog avec un grand sourire en tournant une fois devant le miroir. "Today's concert is finally here! Let's get ready together!"  
Cut 2 (~2s · handheld room tour) Elle se promène en montrant son coin maquillage, les fleurs envoyées par les fans, son micro personnalisé et sa tenue de scène suspendue à proximité. "Look what everyone sent me today!"  
Cut 3 (~2s · medium shot) Elle vaporise du parfum, ajuste un bracelet, puis sourit fièrement au miroir. "Almost ready!"  
Cut 4 (~1.5s · cinematic close-up) Plan détaillé des bijoux scintillants, des ongles vernis et du maquillage pailleté captant la lumière. Mouvement doux du tissu et seuls les sons d’ambiance des coulisses.  
Cut 5 (~2s · selfie) Elle s’entraîne à des poses mignonnes de ending fairy, des finger hearts, des baisers envoyés du bout des doigts, puis éclate de rire après avoir fait une grimace. "Which pose should I do on stage?"  
Cut 6 (~2s · handheld) Une styliste entre rapidement pour ajuster ses cheveux pendant une seconde. Elle glousse tout en restant concentrée sur la caméra. "They're always fixing something!"  
Cut 7 (~2s · selfie walking) Elle traverse le couloir des coulisses en saluant les danseurs et le staff d’un geste joyeux, tandis que tout le monde lui rend son sourire.  
Cut 8 (~2s · final selfie) Le régisseur de scène annonce sa performance. Elle prend une grande inspiration, fait un clin d’œil à la caméra, forme un cœur avec ses deux mains, puis trottine avec excitation vers l’entrée lumineuse de la scène.

Final Line: "Wish me luck... let's make amazing memories together!"

ja.content:
ライブ会場の豪華なバックステージラウンジ、午後遅め。注目を集める女性K-POPアイドルの@imageが、ステージの呼び出しを待ちながら、スマホで楽しい「Get Ready With Me」Vlogを撮影している。雰囲気は温かく、エネルギッシュで、自然体。最初から最後まで自然な手持ちカメラの動きで、テンポの速いダイナミックなカットが入る。彼女は本物の笑顔、いたずらっぽいからかい、アイコンタクト、ふとした笑いを通して、常にレンズとコミュニケーションを取っている。同じ控室の中で、シームレスにつながるVlog風の8ショットが展開し、活気ある舞台裏の体験を生み出す。

Character  
20代前半の韓国人女性アイドル。長く絹のようなダークブラウンの髪にやわらかなウェーブ、輝くガラス肌、印象的なアーモンド形の瞳、淡いピーチメイク、ツヤのある唇、細くエレガントな体型。シルバーアクセサリーと白のニーハイブーツを合わせ、パステルブルーのミニドレスの上にスタイリッシュな白のクロップドカーディガンを着用。かわいく、自信に満ち、自然体で魅力的。

Storyboard  
Cut 1 (~2s · selfie) 彼女は鏡の前でくるっと一回転しながら、明るい笑顔でVlogを始める。  
「今日のコンサート、ついに来たよ！一緒に準備しよう！」

Cut 2 (~2s · handheld room tour) 彼女は歩き回りながら、メイク台、ファンから届いた花、カスタムマイク、近くに掛かったステージ衣装を見せる。  
「みんなが今日送ってくれたもの、見て！」

Cut 3 (~2s · medium shot) 彼女は香水を吹きかけ、ブレスレットを整え、それから鏡に向かって誇らしげに微笑む。  
「もうすぐ準備完了！」

Cut 4 (~1.5s · cinematic close-up) きらめくジュエリー、整えられたネイル、ライトを受けて輝くグリッターメイクのディテールを捉えたショット。やわらかな布の動きと、控室の環境音だけが聞こえる。

Cut 5 (~2s · selfie) 彼女はかわいいエンディング妖精ポーズ、指ハート、投げキスを練習し、変顔をしたあとに笑う。  
「ステージではどのポーズにしようかな？」

Cut 6 (~2s · handheld) スタイリストが素早く入ってきて、彼女の髪を一瞬だけ直す。彼女はカメラに集中したまま、くすくす笑う。  
「いつも何かしら直されるんだよね！」

Cut 7 (~2s · selfie walking) 彼女はバックステージの廊下を歩きながら、ダンサーやスタッフに元気よく手を振って挨拶し、みんなも笑顔で返す。

Cut 8 (~2s · final selfie) ステージマネージャーが彼女の出番を告げる。彼女は深呼吸し、カメラにウィンクして、両手でハートを作り、それから輝くステージ入口へ向かって弾むように駆け出す。

Final Line:  
「幸運を祈っててね……一緒に最高の思い出を作ろう！」

ko.content:
라이브 콘서트 공연장의 럭셔리한 백스테이지 라운지, 늦은 오후. 떠오르는 여성 K-pop 아이돌 @image가 무대 호출을 기다리며 휴대폰으로 재미있는 “Get Ready With Me” 브이로그를 촬영한다. 분위기는 따뜻하고 에너지 넘치며, 진짜 같은 느낌이 살아 있다. 시작부터 끝까지 자연스러운 핸드헬드 카메라 움직임과 빠르고 역동적인 컷 편집이 이어진다. 그녀는 진심 어린 미소, 장난스러운 놀림, 눈맞춤, 즉흥적인 웃음으로 끊임없이 렌즈와 교감한다. 같은 드레싱룸 안에서 매끄럽게 이어지는 8개의 브이로그 스타일 샷이 펼쳐지며, 생생한 비하인드 신을 만들어낸다.

Character  
20대 초반의 한국인 여성 아이돌. 부드러운 웨이브가 있는 길고 매끈한 다크 브라운 헤어, 빛나는 글래스 스킨, 또렷한 아몬드형 눈매, 은은한 피치 메이크업, 윤기 나는 입술, 슬림하고 우아한 체형. 은은한 파스텔 블루 미니 드레스 위에 스타일리시한 화이트 크롭 가디건을 걸치고, 실버 액세서리와 화이트 니하이 부츠를 착용했다. 귀엽고 자신감 넘치며, 자연스럽게 매력적이다.

Storyboard  
Cut 1 (~2s · selfie) 그녀는 거울 앞에서 한 바퀴 돌며 환한 미소로 브이로그를 시작한다. "Today's concert is finally here! Let's get ready together!"  
Cut 2 (~2s · handheld room tour) 그녀는 메이크업 스테이션, 팬들이 보낸 꽃다발, 커스텀 마이크, 근처에 걸려 있는 무대 의상을 보여주며 방 안을 돌아다닌다. "Look what everyone sent me today!"  
Cut 3 (~2s · medium shot) 그녀는 향수를 뿌리고 팔찌를 고친 뒤, 거울을 보며 자랑스럽게 미소 짓는다. "Almost ready!"  
Cut 4 (~1.5s · cinematic close-up) 반짝이는 주얼리, 정돈된 네일, 조명에 반사되는 글리터 메이크업을 디테일하게 담은 샷. 부드러운 천의 움직임과 백스테이지의 주변 소리만 들린다.  
Cut 5 (~2s · selfie) 그녀는 귀여운 엔딩 요정 포즈, 손가락 하트, 날리는 키스를 연습한 뒤, 우스꽝스러운 표정을 짓고 웃는다. "Which pose should I do on stage?"  
Cut 6 (~2s · handheld) 스타일리스트가 잠깐 들어와 그녀의 머리를 빠르게 정리해준다. 그녀는 카메라에 집중한 채 킥킥 웃는다. "They're always fixing something!"  
Cut 7 (~2s · selfie walking) 그녀는 백스테이지 복도를 걸으며 댄서들과 스태프들에게 밝게 손을 흔들고, 모두가 미소로 화답한다.  
Cut 8 (~2s · final selfie) 무대 매니저가 그녀의 공연을 알린다. 그녀는 깊게 숨을 들이마시고 카메라에 윙크한 뒤, 두 손으로 하트를 만들고는 빛나는 무대 입구를 향해 신나게 뛰어간다.

Final Line: "Wish me luck... let's make amazing memories together!"

pt.content:
Lounge luxuoso de bastidores em um local de show ao vivo, no fim da tarde. Uma idol feminina de K-pop em ascensão @image grava um vlog divertido de “Get Ready With Me” no celular enquanto espera ser chamada para o palco. A atmosfera é acolhedora, energética e autêntica. Movimento natural de câmera na mão do início ao fim, com cortes rápidos e dinâmicos. Ela interage constantemente com a lente com sorrisos genuínos, provocações brincalhonas, contato visual e risadas espontâneas. Oito takes contínuos no estilo vlog se desenrolam dentro do mesmo camarim, criando uma experiência animada de bastidores.

Character  
Uma idol coreana na casa dos 20 anos. Cabelo longo, sedoso, castanho-escuro, com ondas suaves, glass skin radiante, olhos amendoados expressivos, maquiagem suave em tom pêssego, lábios brilhantes, corpo esguio e elegante. Vestindo um cardigan cropped branco estiloso sobre um mini vestido azul pastel, com acessórios prateados e botas brancas até o joelho. Fofa, confiante e naturalmente encantadora.

Storyboard  
Cut 1 (~2s · selfie) Ela abre o vlog com um sorriso radiante enquanto gira uma vez em frente ao espelho. "Today's concert is finally here! Let's get ready together!"  
Cut 2 (~2s · handheld room tour) Ela caminha mostrando sua bancada de maquiagem, flores dos fãs, microfone personalizado e a roupa de palco pendurada por perto. "Look what everyone sent me today!"  
Cut 3 (~2s · medium shot) Ela borrifa perfume, ajeita uma pulseira e então sorri orgulhosa para o espelho. "Almost ready!"  
Cut 4 (~1.5s · cinematic close-up) Close detalhado de joias brilhantes, unhas impecáveis e maquiagem com glitter refletindo as luzes. Movimento suave do tecido e apenas sons ambientes dos bastidores.  
Cut 5 (~2s · selfie) Ela pratica poses fofas de ending fairy, finger hearts, beijos jogados, e então ri depois de fazer uma careta engraçada. "Which pose should I do on stage?"  
Cut 6 (~2s · handheld) Uma stylist entra rapidamente para ajustar seu cabelo por um segundo. Ela dá risadinhas enquanto continua focada na câmera. "They're always fixing something!"  
Cut 7 (~2s · selfie walking) Ela caminha pelo corredor dos bastidores, cumprimentando dançarinos e equipe com acenos animados enquanto todos sorriem de volta.  
Cut 8 (~2s · final selfie) O stage manager anuncia sua apresentação. Ela respira fundo, pisca para a câmera, forma um coração com as duas mãos e então corre animada em direção à entrada iluminada do palco.

Final Line: "Wish me luck... let's make amazing memories together!"

zh.content:
豪华的后台休息室，位于一场现场演唱会场馆内，下午晚些时候。一位正在上升期的女团偶像 @image 一边等待上台通知，一边用手机拍摄有趣的 “Get Ready With Me” vlog。整体氛围温暖、充满活力且真实自然。从头到尾采用自然的手持镜头运动，并穿插快速、动感的剪辑。她始终通过真诚的微笑、俏皮的调侃、眼神交流和即兴笑声与镜头互动。八个无缝衔接的 vlog 风格镜头在同一个化妆间内展开，营造出热闹的幕后体验。  
Character  
一位20岁出头的韩国女偶像。留着柔顺的深棕色长发，带有轻柔波浪，拥有发光般的玻璃肌，富有表现力的杏眼，淡蜜桃色妆容，光泽感双唇，身材纤细优雅。身穿时髦的白色短款开衫，内搭淡蓝色迷你连衣裙，配有银色饰品和白色过膝靴。可爱、自信，举手投足间都散发着迷人魅力。  
Storyboard  
Cut 1 (~2s · selfie) 她在镜子前转了一圈，带着灿烂笑容开启 vlog。“今天的演唱会终于到了！一起来准备吧！”  
Cut 2 (~2s · handheld room tour) 她走动着展示自己的化妆台、粉丝送来的花、定制麦克风，以及旁边挂着的舞台服装。“看看大家今天送给我的东西！”  
Cut 3 (~2s · medium shot) 她喷上香水，整理了一下手链，然后对着镜子自豪地微笑。“差不多准备好了！”  
Cut 4 (~1.5s · cinematic close-up) 特写闪亮的珠宝、修饰精致的指甲，以及在灯光下闪烁的亮片妆容。只有柔和的布料摆动声和后台环境音。  
Cut 5 (~2s · selfie) 她练习可爱的 ending fairy 姿势、手指爱心、飞吻，做了个搞怪表情后笑了出来。“我在舞台上该摆哪个姿势呢？”  
Cut 6 (~2s · handheld) 一位造型师迅速进来，短暂帮她调整头发。她一边咯咯笑，一边继续专注看着镜头。“他们总是在帮我修这修那！”  
Cut 7 (~2s · selfie walking) 她走过后台走廊，开心地向舞者和工作人员挥手打招呼，大家也都笑着回应她。  
Cut 8 (~2s · final selfie) 舞台经理通知她该上场了。她深吸一口气，对着镜头眨了眨眼，用双手比出爱心，然后兴奋地小跑向发光的舞台入口。  
Final Line: “祝我好运吧……让我们一起创造美好的回忆！”
